reviews.text:
★★★★★

The staff member who helped us was very friendly and helpful! He kindly explained how to use the cat teaser and introduced us to some grooming tools. We found exactly what we were looking for and were very happy with our purchases. Thank you! 🐱❤️

When paying, I felt that the attitude of the female staff member with long black hair towards foreign customers was not very kind.

She was smiling and chatting cheerfully with the Japanese customers who were paying before us, but when it was our turn, her tone suddenly became brusque, and her expression was clearly displeased.

I felt that her attitude towards us was changed simply because we were foreigners, and it was a very unpleasant experience. I would like to be treated with the same politeness and fairness to both Japanese and foreign customers. I hope that the staff will improve their customer service so that this does not happen again. 😡😡😡

I had a very unpleasant experience with the way I was treated as a foreigner. The staff member who was at the register was very polite, smiling, and kind to the Japanese customer who was paying before me. However, as soon as it was my turn and they realized I was a foreigner, their attitude changed drastically. It was a long-haired female staff member at the register. Her way of speaking suddenly became rude, and her expression clearly showed her displeasure. Even though I was speaking in Japanese, she treated me as if she couldn't understand me, which was very disappointing. The difference in treatment from the Japanese customer to me was so stark that I felt I was treated this way because I was a foreigner. It is extremely unpleasant to change customer service based on nationality. I would like all customers to be treated equally and with at least a minimum level of courtesy.
Very small shop. The selection is limited.
They have a wide variety of pet supplies and treats, and I occasionally shop there.

I've used this store many times.

It's convenient because I can buy things without having to go to Hankyu.

The female employee with blonde highlights was assisting another customer. While I appreciate her effort, the store is small, so please pay attention to your surroundings. Please check if you're blocking other customers' view of the products before moving. She was in the way, and it made me lose my desire to buy anything.

The other day, after paying, a store employee said "You stink!" to me. There were two women at the register in the evening. I've always found the customer service at this store unpleasant. A male employee suddenly turned around and looked surprised when he saw me, a customer, without even saying "Welcome." I think the products are good, but the customer service is inconsistent, so I will never go there again.

The staff was so friendly and I bought THE CUTEST plush ever!  Also, after I got back home, I was hoping to find more information on this plush so I wrote to the store. The store manager (Sugimoto) wrote back super fast and was so incredibly helpful! This shop is a must visit on my next trip!
It's fun because there are so many different snacks to choose from. It's also very convenient as it's close to Hankyu Umeda Station.
Not many options for larger dogs. Prices are fair for what they have. Great for smaller dogs and niche items.

They sell slightly more expensive, high-quality cat food and treats, as well as cute collars and toys.

Once, when I ran out of cat food due to my own mistake and called them in a panic, they kindly reserved some for me, and I was able to pick it up the next day, which was a lifesaver.

The staff are also very polite and helpful.
It might be hard to find, but it is the closest store to Osaka Namba Station.
